# Handbooks
Access Aadhaar handbooks, resident guides and valid document lists in multiple regional languages. These resources help residents, agencies, and partners understand Aadhaar enrolment, updates, verification, accepted documents and usage opportunities across services, including fintech and governance initiatives.
